# Creative Market (creativemarket.com)

Creative Market's public signed-out surface — the home page, the /fonts category, a product page, /search, /membership and the /sign-in card — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and category pages at 390 x 844. The account, purchases, downloads and the sell studio sit behind sign-in; Log In was never pressed and nothing was added to the cart.

## What this is

A Rails storefront with a Vue island layer, painted under `data-theme="legacy"` — the one theme. Its Sass sheets are served from the cross-origin CloudFront CDN, so the custom-property layer is modest: ~35 `--default-*`/`--dialog-*`/`--user-dropdown-*`/`--container-*` globals plus ~130 component-scoped vars — the `.ui-button--*` skins (`--_color` teal/accent, `--_color-hover`, `--_color-soft`), `.ui-select` states and scrollbar metrics. Most of the design lives in compiled literal CSS, so measured computed values do the heavy lifting.

## The design language

- **White page, ink text, teal actions.** #303538 ink on #ffffff; every primary action — Add to cart, Log In, the cart glyph, the search button — is #088178 teal on white, lifting to #003a37 on hover.
- **Purple as the accent, not the brand.** #4e42a1 marks the Save 25% pill, the membership hero and the accent button skin (#281f6b hover, #edeeff wash); #d53a9d pink only appears on SALE.
- **Averta everywhere.** One licensed face: 600 on every heading (72px membership hero, 48px page h1, 36px sign-in, 24px product title), 400 on UI text at 13-16px, 600 again on buttons and links at 14px.
- **Two radii languages.** The refreshed surfaces run 8px buttons, 16px cards and 20-32px pills; the legacy sign-in card still paints 3px controls. Fields sit on #fafdff with the declared 0.4s ease transition.
- **Commerce chrome.** A 73px header with the 585x44 All Categories search; product pages carry a 450px buy box — 24px license radio rows, 45px teal Add to cart, 40px outlined Buy now — beside accordion'd reviews and the Meet-the-shop card.

## Boundaries

- **Captured with the automation flag masked.** The public capture (`tools/capture/public/`) hid `navigator.webdriver` from every page, so the committed readings and screenshots it took were taken past that mask. The scripts no longer hide it (edited, not run); a recapture that meets a bot check records it as a boundary.
- A later signed-in pass (2026-11-20, T3 preview, already signed in) opened the account menu, My purchases (empty) and My profile. Settings redirects to /account/unauthorized-device. The shop menu, messages, notifications, collections, likes and a 390-wide pass were not screenshotted: the preview stopped producing frames. Nothing was purchased, published or submitted. The public /sign-in card is unchanged: Log In was never pressed in that earlier capture.
- Add to cart, Buy now, the license radios, the bundle checkboxes, every membership CTA and Save 25% were measured, never followed; nothing entered the cart.
- The CookieYes consent banner and the "Licensing Questions? Let's Chat!" launcher were hidden via the overlay hider, never answered.
- The nav dropdowns (FONTS, TEMPLATES, MORE, All Categories facet) were never opened.
- Cloudflare Turnstile greets some routes headless; fresh contexts and patient waits cleared it this run — a still-blocked route is a boundary, not a bypass target.
- The product page's "More from this shop" / "Similar Fonts" rails rendered empty; related-card is recorded as a miss.
- No standalone icon set was lifted; the wordmark, glyphs and product artwork are the product's.
- Euclid-free: Averta is licensed and served from CloudFront, not shipped; style-guide.html falls back to system sans.
